Tools

ReDUA repository-scale interface for finding, filtering, contextualizing, and reusing public tandem mass-spectrometry data through standardized sample metadata. 21 August 2026 MassIVEA public repository for depositing, preserving, browsing, downloading, and reusing mass-spectrometry datasets, including datasets connected to GNPS analyses. 21 August 2026 MSMS-ChooserA GNPS workflow for automatically selecting candidate reference MS/MS spectra from LC-MS data of known standards using supplied molecular structures and expected precursor masses. 21 August 2026 MASSTA GNPS web search tool that queries an MS/MS spectrum across public mass-spectrometry datasets and spectral libraries to identify where related spectra occur. 21 August 2026

Protocols

Reverse metabolomicsA discovery strategy that starts from a candidate chemical structure or reference MS/MS spectrum, searches public metabolomics repositories for matching spectra, and uses sample metadata to reveal biological or phenotypic associations. 2024 Native MS metabolomics for metal-binding compoundsA transferable LC-MS strategy that combines post-column pH adjustment and metal infusion with ion identity molecular networking to discover small molecules that bind metals in complex biological samples. 2022
